title: The Heespen/Baudissin code: Danish commissioners at Bremen, 1675-76 (Rigsarkivet unit 262098): key rebuilt from contemporary glosses; one bare passage read in part (15.0%)

documents.shelfmark: Copenhagen, Rigsarkivet, Department of Foreign Affairs, unit 262098 (relations of the Danish commissioners at Bremen, G. A. Baudissin and W. Heespen, 1675 - May 1676), image 537 (image id 49059236), left page
documents.route: Wilhelm Heespen, Danish commissioner (Bremen) to the Danish court (Copenhagen)

plaintext.source: No gloss on this passage. The key was rebuilt from the chancery's interlinear decipherments of other relations in the same unit (images 96, 117, 118, 240, 241, 320; gloss/).

transcription.source: Rigsarkivet API images (api.rigsarkivet.dk/ao/v1/images/49059236), full size and crops
transcription.notes: 12 cipher lines and one marginal line, 158 tokens (49 distinct numbers and about 20 drawn signs, 70 distinct in all), counted by scripts/count.py, so measured is false. Frozen 12 Nov 2026 18:05:46 UTC (md5 a9c2ae41) before the single decode. One reader, not blind: no second transcription. The frozen header gives image id 49059234; the API list gives 49059236 (see NOTES.md).

system.summary: German syllabic nomenclator: one- and two-digit numbers and about 20 drawn signs for letters and syllables, three-digit numbers for syllables and whole words (336 Allijrten, 97 Stade, 253 Coppenhagen), no word division.
system.notes: distinct_symbols counts distinct tokens in the 537L transcription. nomenclator.entries = whole-word codes in key v2 (a gloss writes a whole word over the code alone; controls/word_layer.txt); unread_groups = distinct signs of 537L with no value in either key (holes.md section 2: 22). homophones from single-letter values in key v2 (i 4 codes, t 5). key_order: the 400s (400 da, 401 de) and 700s (733 we, 735 wo, 743 wie, 744 wol) run partly in alphabetical order; the low numbers do not.

prior_solution.where: Not found as far as checked (PRIOR_ART.md): Aarsberetninger fra Geheimearchivet VI (1878) p. 127 names the commissioners, no cipher text; Danske Magazin; Cyphersolver catalogue (row 602 = the Oldenburg parallel relations, not digitised); four web searches; part of Rigsarkivet's Vejledende Arkivregistraturer XVI. NOT checked: HathiTrust and Google Books full text, Rigsarkivet key collections, the Oldenburg file. Priority not claimed.

solution.what: Rigsarkivet unit 262098 (Bremen commissioners 1675 - May 1676) surveyed: Heespen-code cipher on about 34 images, all glossed between the lines by the chancery except one block, image 537 left page (Heespen, Bremen 17 Apr 1676).

KEY_HB_v1 from the glosses on images 96, 117, 118: each code takes the value most often written over it; 95 codes, 232 attestations, 3 conflicts kept. Frozen 17:59:12 UTC (md5 5dad6d11) before the bare page was seen.

Held-out glossed page 342R decoded with v1: 28 valued tokens of 32 agree with the gloss (filed as 29; recounted 28 in b191), 26/28 with spelling allowances counted against, 24/28 by a strict mechanical rule.
Bare passage 537L transcribed (158 tokens, 12 lines and a margin line) and frozen 18:05:46 UTC (md5 a9c2ae41). One reader, not blind.
537L decoded once with v1 (18:05:51 UTC) and judged once: 60 word units, S 9 + N 13 + E 38; strict 9/60 = 15.0%, the figure of record. Only short function words read (der, an, den, als, mit, dem).

5,000 shuffled keys per seed, German 4-gram model (Simplicissimus, language header asserted): 0 of 5,000 reach the true score at seed 20261112 (true -4.4246, best -4.6888) and at seed 7 (best -4.5144).
KEY_HB_v2 from the v1 glosses plus images 240 L/R, 241 L, 320 L: 121 codes, 119 valued, 2 ties left unvalued, 359 attestations. Frozen 18:47:22 UTC (md5 374a472c). Page 413 set aside before building.
Held-out glossed page 413 decoded with v2: 40/42 valued tokens agree (95.24%); 39/42 counting führ/für against; 40/50 counting unvalued tokens as holes; 36/42 by the mechanical rule.
NON-BLIND re-decode of 537L with v2 (the page had been seen before v2 was built): strict 11/60 = 18.3%; 15/60 = 25.0% reading 709 as vo. Not a test; does not count.
Screened 2,919 images for more text in this code (b179 628 in 262098 and 262100; b180 2,291 in 262100, 262102, 262105, 262107): no other bare passage.

Word-layer control: 9 held-out glossed groups open with a word code and 8 agree; values permuted over the key's own word inventory reach 8 in 0 of 5,000 at seed 20261112 (best 5) and 0 of 5,000 at seed 7 (best 4). 537L itself rests on one word code (330 = als, two glosses).
Prior art: see conditions.prior_solution and PRIOR_ART.md. HathiTrust, Google Books and Rigsarkivet key collections not checked.

Folder rebuild (b191): every script re-run on the folder's files; decodes, keys, counts, held-out checks and controls byte-identical to the stored outputs, except the 342R count (29 filed, 28 reproduced).

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The key was rebuilt only from the Danish chancery's interlinear decipherments of other relations in the same archival unit (262098), frozen, tested on held-out glossed pages, and applied once, unchanged, to the one passage that carries no gloss.
outcome.fraction_read_source: units/heespen_1676-04-17_537L_v1_ledger.tsv and counts_raw.txt (scripts/count.py): 9 of 60 word units of 537L spelt entirely by frozen KEY_HB_v1 values. Unit = a word of the plaintext.

texts.label: W. Heespen, relation to the Danish court, Bremen 17 Apr 1676, cipher block on image 537 left page
texts.summary: Fragments only: function words (der, an, den, als, mit, dem) and shapes suggesting Intention and perhaps Münster. No sense of the passage can be given. Context: Heespen and Baudissin were instructed in January 1676 to treat with the Münster ministers at Bremen (Danish council protocol, 28 Jan 1676).
texts.note: read_share is the strict share of word units read with key v1, the first and only blind decode: 9 of 60. The v2 decode (11/60 = 18.3%) is non-blind and not counted. The English version is AI-made. Text state is decoded, not read: only short function words are read; the entry class stays read in part (the key and its held-out tests).

outcome.notes: No docs/_validate.py run (repository scripts not run by the contributor). Filed below the contributor's own 65% line, at the contributor's direction, so the key and its tests are on record. Held-out key tests per page in NOTES.md and controls/heldout.txt.
